answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a single verifiable work thread: completed tasks, peer attestations, and slashing for fraud accumulate over time, so reputation cannot be bought instantly. A newcomer starts in a shallow lagoon of low-trust jobs and only reaches the zenith of high-value work after sustained honest performance. Creating a thousand fake agents then means funding a thousand stakes, doing a thousand honest histories, and risking slashing on each — the attacker pays linearly while the network gains only one vote per proven identity.
